一致性優先（CP）

segments.en: If a side can't confirm with the official count, it refuses. Every answer is correct, but some fans get an error until the network heals.
segments.zh: 如果某一邊無法向官方座位數確認，它就拒絕。每個回答都是正確的，但在網路恢復之前，有些歌迷會看到錯誤。
可用性優先（AP）

segments.en: Every side keeps answering with what it knows. Nobody gets an error, but the two sides can disagree, and you have to clean up the conflicts afterwards.
segments.zh: 每一邊都繼續回應自己所知道的。沒有人會看到錯誤，但兩邊可能意見不同，事後你得收拾這些衝突。
關鍵差別

segments.en: The CAP theorem says that when the network is partitioned (split so parts can't talk), a system must choose: stay consistent by refusing some requests, or stay available by answering with data that might be wrong. Partitions aren't optional, so the real question is which one you pick, for each kind of data.
segments.zh: CAP 定理說的是：當網路發生分割（partition）（被切開、彼此無法溝通）時，系統必須選擇：拒絕部分請求以保持一致（consistent），或是用可能錯誤的資料回應以保持可用（available）。網路分割不是可選的，所以真正的問題是你為每一種資料選擇哪一邊。

網路分割

segments.en: Links fail, routers misbehave, a data center goes dark. Parts of your system can't talk while still running.
segments.zh: 線路會斷、路由器會出錯、資料中心會停電。你系統的各個部分還在運作，卻無法互相溝通。
選擇

segments.en: During a partition: refuse to stay correct (CP), or answer to stay up (AP). You can't have both at once.
segments.zh: 分割期間：拒絕以保持正確（CP），或回應以保持運作（AP）。兩者無法同時擁有。
依資料而定
刻意做選擇

segments.en: Seats and payments: consistency. Likes, view counts, recommendations: availability. One app can make different choices for each.
segments.zh: 座位和付款：一致性。按讚、瀏覽次數、推薦：可用性。同一個 App 可以對每種資料做不同的選擇。
取捨

segments.en: CP costs availability during partitions; AP costs correctness and needs conflict resolution afterwards. Even without a partition there's a smaller version of the same trade: waiting for the other side to confirm (consistent) is slower than answering locally (fast).
segments.zh: CP 在分割期間犧牲可用性；AP 犧牲正確性，事後還需要解決衝突。即使沒有分割，也有一個較小版本的同樣取捨：等另一邊確認（一致）比在本地直接回應（快）要慢。

segments.en: 'Every sale is confirmed by both data centers. Both always show the same count.'
segments.zh: '每筆銷售都由兩個資料中心確認。兩邊顯示的座位數永遠一樣。'
'選擇可用性優先，然後切斷網路。'

segments.en: 'Both sides keep selling from their own copy of the count. No fan sees an error.'
segments.zh: '兩邊都依自己手上的座位數繼續販售。沒有歌迷看到錯誤。'
'等幾秒鐘，然後重新連線。'

segments.en: 'Now the two sides compare notes and find they sold the same seats twice. (If it sold out first, Reset and cut sooner.)'
segments.zh: '現在兩邊互相核對，發現同樣的座位被賣了兩次。（如果先賣完了，就按重設，早一點切斷網路。）'

segments.en: 'Press ↺ Reset, choose Consistency first, and cut the network again.'
segments.zh: '按↺ 重設，選擇一致性優先，再切斷一次網路。'

segments.en: 'The EU side can\'t confirm with the official count, so it turns fans away. No seat is ever sold twice.'
segments.zh: '歐洲那邊無法向官方座位數確認，所以把歌迷擋下來。沒有任何一個座位被賣兩次。'

segments.en: '🔌 Connected: every sale is confirmed by both sides.'

'按「播放」開始販售。'

segments.en: `✕ After reconnecting: ${S.oversold} fans hold tickets for seats that don't exist. Both sides sold from their own copy of “seats left”. Someone now has to email, refund and apologize.`
segments.zh: `✕ 重新連線後：有 ${S.oversold} 位歌迷拿著不存在的座位的票。兩邊都依自己那份「剩餘座位」在賣。現在得有人去寄信、退款、道歉。`

segments.en: '⚠ Both sides are selling and every fan gets an answer, but the two counts are drifting apart. Nobody knows yet.'
segments.zh: '⚠ 兩邊都在賣，每位歌迷都得到回應，但兩邊的座位數正在漸行漸遠。目前還沒有人知道。'

segments.en: `⚠ The EU side is refusing purchases (${S.eu.refused} fans so far): it can't confirm with the official count. Everything that was sold is real.`
segments.zh: `⚠ 歐洲那邊正在拒絕購買（目前擋下 ${S.eu.refused} 位歌迷）：它無法向官方座位數確認。所有賣出去的都是真的。`

segments.en: '✓ Sold out, with exactly 20 tickets for 20 seats.'
segments.zh: '✓ 售罄，20 個座位剛好賣出 20 張票。'

segments.en: `✓ Consistent: both data centers agree that ${S.official} seats are left.`
segments.zh: `✓ 一致：兩個資料中心都同意還剩 ${S.official} 個座位。`
'一致性優先（CP）'
'可用性優先（AP）'

segments.en: '-- availability first: any one replica may answer'
segments.zh: '-- 可用性優先：任何一個副本都可以回應'

segments.en: 'SELECT seats_left FROM concerts WHERE id = \'reunion-1\';'
'-- consistency first: a majority of replicas must agree'
segments.zh: '-- 一致性優先：必須有過半數的副本同意'

segments.en: 'UPDATE concerts SET seats_left = 11 WHERE id = \'reunion-1\''
' IF seats_left = 12; -- only if nobody else changed it'
'-- during a partition, the minority side gets:'
segments.zh: '-- 分割期間，少數那一邊會收到：'

segments.en: '-- Unavailable: Cannot achieve consistency level QUORUM'
'Answer as soon as any single replica responds. Works even if the others are unreachable, so it\'s always available, but it might return an old value. The lab\'s “Availability first”.'
segments.zh: '只要任何一個副本回應就回答。即使其他副本連不上也能運作，所以永遠可用，但可能回傳舊的值。這就是實驗室的「可用性優先」。'
'快，但可能過期'

segments.en: 'Fine for a seat map that refreshes, or a like counter. Not for deciding whether a seat can be sold.'
segments.zh: '適合會自動更新的座位圖或按讚計數器。不適合拿來決定一個座位能不能賣。'

segments.en: 'A majority of replicas must respond. If a partition leaves you on the smaller side, there\'s no majority, and the request fails instead of guessing. The lab\'s “Consistency first”.'
segments.zh: '必須有過半數的副本回應。如果分割讓你落在較小的那一邊，就沒有過半數，請求會失敗而不是用猜的。這就是實驗室的「一致性優先」。'
'有條件的寫入'

segments.en: 'Only sell if the count is still what you saw. Combined with a quorum, two sides can\'t both sell the same seat.'
segments.zh: '只有在座位數仍然是你看到的那個值時才賣。搭配過半數（quorum），兩邊就不可能賣出同一個座位。'
'一致性的代價'

segments.en: 'This error is the “refusing” EU data center from the lab. It\'s a correct answer: “I can\'t know right now.”'
segments.zh: '這個錯誤就是實驗室裡那個「拒絕中」的歐洲資料中心。它是一個正確的回答：「我現在無法確定。」'

segments.en: 'Which Encore feature should stay correct (CP) even if that means errors during a partition?'
segments.zh: 'Encore 的哪個功能應該保持正確（CP），即使代價是分割期間會出現錯誤？'
'「正在看這場演唱會的人數」計數器'

segments.en: 'If it\'s a little off for a few minutes, nobody is harmed. Availability is the better choice.'
segments.zh: '就算幾分鐘內有點不準，也不會有人受害。可用性是比較好的選擇。'

segments.en: 'Selling the last seats of a concert'
segments.zh: '賣出演唱會的最後幾個座位'

segments.en: 'Two fans paying for the same seat is worse than one fan seeing “try again in a minute”.'
segments.zh: '兩位歌迷為同一個座位付錢，比一位歌迷看到「請一分鐘後再試」糟糕得多。'
'演唱會推薦'

segments.en: 'Stale recommendations are harmless. Keep them available.'
segments.zh: '過時的推薦沒有傷害。讓它保持可用。'

segments.en: '“We\'ll just choose CA: consistent and available, and skip partition tolerance.” What\'s wrong with that?'
segments.zh: '「我們就選 CA 吧：一致又可用，跳過分割容忍。」這有什麼問題？'
'沒問題，這是很常見的選擇'

segments.en: 'Only for a system that runs on a single machine, where there\'s no network to partition.'
segments.zh: '只適用於跑在單一機器上、根本沒有網路可以被分割的系統。'

segments.en: 'Partitions happen whether you plan for them or not; the only choice is how to behave when they do'
segments.zh: '不管你有沒有規劃，分割都會發生；唯一的選擇是發生時要怎麼表現'

segments.en: 'For any system spread across machines, “P” isn\'t optional. The real choice is C or A during a partition.'
segments.zh: '對任何分散在多台機器上的系統，「P」都不是可選的。真正的選擇是分割期間要 C 還是 A。'
'CA 系統比較慢'

segments.en: 'Speed isn\'t the issue. A distributed system can\'t opt out of network failures.'
segments.zh: '問題不在速度。分散式系統無法選擇不面對網路故障。'

segments.en: 'After a partition heals, an availability-first system finds that both sides changed the same record. What has to happen?'
segments.zh: '分割恢復後，一個可用性優先的系統發現兩邊都改了同一筆資料。接下來必須怎麼做？'
'什麼都不用：資料庫會完美地合併'

segments.en: 'Sometimes it can (counters, sets), but conflicting decisions like two sales of one seat need a rule or a person.'
segments.zh: '有時候可以（計數器、集合），但像同一個座位賣了兩次這種互相衝突的決定，就需要規則或由人處理。'

segments.en: 'Conflict resolution: pick a winner (for example, last write wins), merge, or fix it by hand, such as refunding a fan'
segments.zh: '衝突解決：選出贏家（例如最後寫入者勝）、合併，或手動修正，例如退款給某位歌迷'

segments.en: 'AP systems move the problem from “error now” to “clean up later”. Plan the cleanup before you need it.'
segments.zh: 'AP 系統把問題從「現在出錯」轉成「之後收拾」。在需要之前就先規劃好收拾的方法。'
'從備份還原'

segments.en: 'Both sides\' changes are real. A backup would throw away valid sales.'
segments.zh: '兩邊的變更都是真的。備份會把合法的銷售一起丟掉。'
